qe: What is the 'Weighted Voting' system in the GST Council under Article 279A?
qh: GST परिषद में 'भारित मतदान' (Weighted Voting) प्रणाली क्या है?
o: Centre 1/3 and States 2/3
Centre 1/2 and States 1/2
Centre 1/4 and States 3/4
Equal votes for all members
e: GST Council (Article 279A) mein 'bhaar-sahit matdan' (weighted voting) ka matlab yahi hai ki kendra sarkar ke paas 1/3 bhaar (weight) hota hai aur sabhi rajyaon ke paas kul 2/3 bhaar - kendra akele apni 1/3 bhaar se faisla nahi thop sakta, aur rajyaon ka kul bhaar 2/3 hai jismein har rajya ke vote ka bhaar (weight) hota hai (aam taur par jansankhya ke aadhar par). Koi bhi nirnay (decision) 3/4 bahumat se paas hota hai, jismein kendra ke 1/3 aur rajyaon ke 2/3 se bahumat lena zaroori hai - yani kendra ya rajyaon ki koi bhi taraf akele apni marzi se faisla nahi thop sakti. Isi vyavastha ka maksad sahakari sanghiyta (cooperative federalism) hai. Isliye aadha-aadha, ek-chauthai-teen-chauthai ya sabke barabar vote jaisi baatein Article 279A ke pravdhanon mein nahi miltin. Exam point: GST Council = kendra 1/3, rajya 2/3 bhaar; faisla 3/4 bahumat se (Article 279A).

qe: Which Constitutional Body is responsible for determining the criteria for distributing Grants-in-aid to States?
qh: राज्यों को सहायता अनुदान (Grants-in-aid) वितरित करने के मानदंड तय करने के लिए कौन सा संवैधानिक निकाय जिम्मेदार है?
o: Comptroller and Auditor General
NITI Aayog
GST Council
Finance Commission
e: Rajyaon ko 'sahayta-anudaan' (Grants-in-aid) dene ke siddhant aur unki rashi (amount) tay karne wali samvidhanik sanstha Vitta Aayog (Finance Commission) hai - Article 280 ke teht rashtrapati pratyek paanch saal mein ek Vitta Aayog banate hain, jo (1) kendra aur rajyaon ke beech kar (tax) ke bantware ki sifarish karta hai aur (2) rajyaon ko di jaane wali grants-in-aid ka nirdharan karta hai. CAG keval lekhaparishan (audit) karta hai, NITI Aayog niti (policy) salah deta hai (khas kar vikas ke mamlon mein), aur GST Council GST ki dar (rates) tay karne ka kaam dekhta hai. Isliye grants-in-aid ke criteria ka sahi jod Finance Commission hai. Exam point: grants-in-aid ke siddhant = Finance Commission (Article 280); ye rashtrapati dwara har 5 saal mein banayi jaati hai.

qe: Can the Supreme Court review the advice given by the Election Commission to the President on MP disqualification?
qh: क्या सुप्रीम कोर्ट सांसदों की अयोग्यता पर चुनाव आयोग द्वारा राष्ट्रपति को दी गई सलाह की न्यायिक समीक्षा कर सकता है?
o: Only if the Chief Justice permits
Yes, it is subject to Judicial Review
Only if Parliament passes a resolution
No, President's order is absolute
e: Nirvaachan aayog (Election Commission) ki raay ke aadhar par rashtrapati jab kisi MP ko nirhrit (disqualify) karte hain, to ye karyavahi nyayik samiksha (judicial review) ke daayre mein aati hai - yani peedit vyakti High Court/Supreme Court mein writ ya anya upay le sakta hai, kyunki ulta nirnay uske sansadiya adhikar ko chhinta hai aur Article 102 wala faisla non-arbitrary hona chahiye. Ismein CJI ki anumati, sansad ka prastav ya koi 'absolute' shakti wali baat samvidhan mein nahi hai. Dhyan rahe - rashtrapati nirvaachan aayog ki raay ke bina nahi chal sakte (wo raay unke liye baandhne wali hoti hai), par uske baad bhi karyavahi adalat ke nirikshan se bahar nahi hoti. Exam point: MP nirhrit par rashtrapati ka aadesh = Election Commission ki raay par aadharit, aur judicial review ke daayre mein (Article 102).

qe: The 'Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities' provided under Article 350B belongs to which administrative service?
qh: 'भाषाई अल्पसंख्यकों के लिए विशेष अधिकारी' किस सेवा से संबंधित होता है?
o: Judicial Service
Defense Services
Elected Member of Parliament
Administrative Service (IAS or equivalent)
e: Article 350B ke teht bhashik alpsankhyakon ke liye niyukt 'Vishesh Adhikari' (Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities) ko prashasnik seva (administrative service - typically IAS ya samkaksh) se liya jaata hai, aur ye aadhikari rashtrapati dwara niyukt hota hai; iska kaam alpsankhyak bhaashaon ke adhikaron aur samvidhanik surakshaon se jude mamlon ki jaanch karke rashtrapati ko report dena hai, aur wahi report sansad ke saamne rakhi jaati hai. Ye pad koi chunavi (elected) ya nyayik pad nahi hai. Shiksha, sarkari kaam aur bhaasha ke mamlon mein ye karyalaya alpsankhyak vargon ki shikayat sunta hai. Exam point: Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities (Article 350B) = prashasnik seva (IAS ya samkaksh) ka adhikari, rashtrapati dwara niyukt.

qe: Who has the constitutional authority to extend the functions and jurisdiction of the State Public Service Commission (BPSC)?
qh: राज्य लोक सेवा आयोग (BPSC) के कार्यों और अधिकार क्षेत्र का विस्तार करने की शक्ति किसके पास है?
o: UPSC Chairman
The Governor through executive order
The State Legislature by enacting a Law
The Chief Minister in Cabinet
e: Rajya Lok Seva Aayog (jaise BPSC) ke kaam-kaaj ka vistar badhane ka adhikar rajya vidhan mandal (State Legislature) ke paas hai, aur wo bhi kanoon (law) banakar - Article 315(2) ke teht aisi vidhi se aayog ke anya kaam (jaise kuchh anya sansthon ke liye chayan) tay kiye ja sakte hain. Rajyapal ke executive aadesh, UPSC ka adhyaksh, ya mukhya mantri ki cabinet is vistar ko nahi kar sakti, kyunki ye samvidhanik dhanche (constitutional framework) mein badlav hai aur iske liye vidhayika ki swikriti zaroori hai. Isi tarah rajya aayog ke sadasyaon ki niyukti aur unki seva-shartein bhi samvidhanik pravdhanon ke aadhar par tay hoti hain (Article 316). Exam point: SPSC ke kaam ka vistar = rajya vidhan mandal ka kanoon (Article 315(2)); Rajyapal ke aadesh se nahi.

qe: By which Constitutional Amendment was the National Commission for SCs and STs transformed from a single officer into a multi-member constitutional body?
qh: किस संशोधन द्वारा SC/ST आयोग को एकल अधिकारी से एक बहु-सदस्यीय निकाय बनाया गया था?
o: 102nd Amendment Act
65th Amendment Act (1990)
42nd Amendment Act
89th Amendment Act
e: Anusuchit Jaati aur Anusuchit Janjati ke liye pehle ek 'vishesh adhikari' (Special Officer) ki vyavastha thi, jise 65th samvidhan sanshodhan, 1990 dwara ek bahu-sadasy (multi-member) samvidhanik aayog - Rashtriya Anusuchit Jaati evam Janjati Aayog (National Commission for SCs and STs) - mein badal diya gaya. Aage chal kar 89th samvidhan sanshodhan, 2003 ne isi aayog ko do alag-aalag aayogon mein baant diya: Article 338 ke teht National Commission for Scheduled Castes aur Article 338A ke teht National Commission for Scheduled Tribes. 102nd sanshodhan (2018) NCBC ko samvidhanik darja dene ke liye tha aur 42nd sanshodhan (1976) DPSP/anyak pravdhanon ke liye - isliye sahi jod 65th sanshodhan hai. Exam point: SC/ST ke liye bahu-sadasy aayog = 65th sanshodhan (1990); alag-alag aayog = 89th sanshodhan (2003).

qe: Which constitutional body maintains and prepares the electoral roll for Parliament and State Legislative Assemblies?
qh: संसद और राज्य विधानसभा चुनावों के लिए मतदाता सूची कौन तैयार और प्रबंधित करता है?
o: Election Commission of India (ECI)
District Magistrate alone
Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs
State Election Commission
e: Lok Sabha aur rajya vidhan sabhaon ke chunav ke liye nirvachak naamavali (electoral roll) banane aur use taza (update) rakhne ka kaam Election Commission of India (ECI) karta hai - Article 324 ke teht ECI hi rashtriya star par chunav ki adhikshta (superintendence) rakhta hai, aur isi ke tahat voter list ka nirmann, sanshodhan aur prakaashan hota hai; Article 325/326 vote ke adhikar aur vayask matadhikar (adult suffrage) se juda hai. Panchayat aur nagarpalika ke chunav ki naamavali rajya nirvachan aayog (State Election Commission) dekhta hai - wo alag sanstha hai. Isliye 'District Magistrate akele', 'Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs' ya 'SEC' wale vikalp sansad/assembly ke chunav ke liye galat hain. Exam point: sansad aur vidhan sabhaon ki electoral roll = Election Commission of India (Article 324); panchayat/nagar nikay = State Election Commission.

qe: Under Article 148, who determines the salary, allowances, and pension conditions of the CAG of India?
qh: अनुच्छेद 148 के तहत, CAG का वेतन और सेवा शर्तें किसके द्वारा निर्धारित की जाती हैं?
o: Union Finance Ministry
Parliament by Law
Public Accounts Committee
The President by executive order
e: CAG (Comptroller and Auditor General) ke vetan-bhatte aur unki sewa-shartein (service conditions) aur pension aadi ka nirdharan Parliament ke kanoon (law) dwara hota hai - Article 148(3) ke teht ye vyavastha hai, taaki CAG ki swatantrata bani rahe; unka vetan-pension kendra ki sammilit nidhi (Consolidated Fund of India) par bhaar (charge) hota hai, jise har saal sansad ki manzoori ke liye rakha jaata hai. Unhe kisi bhi karyakal mein 'niji laabh' ke liye kam nahi kiya ja sakta, aur unhe Supreme Court ke judge ki tarah hi hataya ja sakta hai (Article 148(1)). Vitt Mantralaya, PAC ya rashtrapati ka executive aadesh unki sewa-shartein tay nahi karta. Exam point: CAG ki salary/service conditions = Parliament ka kanoon (Article 148(3)); hataane ka tareeka = SC judge ki prakriya jaisa.

qe: Under Article 319, can a serving or retired member of one Public Service Commission hold membership in another simultaneously?
qh: क्या कोई व्यक्ति एक ही समय में दो लोक सेवा आयोगों का सदस्य रह सकता है?
o: Yes, if approved by Governor
No, simultaneous double membership is prohibited
Yes, with Prime Minister's consent
Only in case of Union Territories
e: Article 319 ke anusaar ek hi vyakti ek saath do ya adhik Lok Seva Aayogon (jaise UPSC aur kisi rajya aayog, ya do rajyaon ke aayog) ka sadasya nahi ho sakta - yani 'dohri sadasyata' (double membership) par rok hai; isi tarah aayog ke sadasya ke banne ke baad kuchh anya padaon par ek samay seema ke saath jaana niyamit hai. Iska maksad yahi hai ki aayog ki swatantrata aur nishpakshata bani rahe, kyunki ek hi vyakti do rajyaon ke chayan mein swarth ka sambandh rakh sakta hai. Rajyapal ki anumati, PM ki sahmati ya UT ki baat is pravdhan ka hissa nahi hai. Exam point: Article 319 = ek samay mein ek hi vyakti ek PSC (ek rajya ya UPSC) ka sadasya ho sakta hai, do ke na ho; hataye ke baad bhi niyamit prayog.

qe: Article 329 places a constitutional bar on the interference of courts in which specific matter?
qh: अनुच्छेद 329 किन मामलों में अदालतों के हस्तक्षेप पर रोक लगाता है?
o: Tax dispute resolution during voting periods
Post-election election petitions
Electoral matters such as delimitation of constituencies and allocation of seats
Fundamental rights violations during elections
e: Article 329 ke anusaar kisi bhi vidhayak sanstha ke chunav ke baare mein adalaton ka dakhal ek khaas seema tak hi hota hai - samvidhan saaf kehta hai ki chunav kshetron ka parisarhad (delimitation) aur sadasyon ka aavantan (allotment) aise mamlon mein adalat sawaal nahi utha sakti (unki jaanch adalaton ke daayre se bahar hai). Haan, chunav ke baad us chunav ko chunauti dene ka raasta 'election petition' hai, jo High Court mein jaata hai (jaisa RPA 1951 mein tay hai). Niti vivad, tax vivad ya mool adhikar ullanghan is pravdhan ke nahi - isliye 'delimitation aur seat allotment' wala jod hi sahi hai. Exam point: Article 329 = delimitation/allotment jaisi chunav-sambandhi mamlon mein adalat ka dakhal nahi; baad ki chunauti keval election petition se (High Court).

qe: On what specific constitutional grounds can the Advocate General of a State be removed from office by the Governor?
qh: राज्यपाल द्वारा राज्य के महाधिवक्ता को किस आधार पर हटाया जा सकता है?
o: At any time under the Governor's pleasure without specified grounds
Through a two-thirds majority resolution of the Assembly
Incapacity determined by High Court
Proven misbehaviour after Supreme Court inquiry
e: Rajya ka Mahadhivakta (Advocate General) apna pad 'Rajyapal ke prasannata (pleasure) ke dauran' (during the pleasure of the Governor) dharan karta hai - yaani Rajyapal kabhi bhi, bina koi khaas karan bataye, unhe pada se hata sakte hain; isliye unhe 'proven misbehaviour', High Court ki jaanch ya vidhan sabha ke prastav jaisi prakriya ke bina bhi hata diya ja sakta hai (yahi vyavastha kendra ke Attorney General ke liye bhi hai, jo rashtrapati ke pleasure par kaam karte hain). Vidhik salahkar hone ke naate ye ek executive (prashasnik) pad hai, nyayadhishon jaisa sakht hataye ka dhancha ismein nahi hai. Isliye sahi jod 'Rajyapal ki marzi (pleasure) se bina khaas karan' hi hai. Exam point: Advocate General ka pad = Rajyapal ki pleasure tak (Article 165); koi impeachment jaisi prakriya nahi.

qe: Why is the Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) famously described as the 'Friend, Philosopher, and Guide' of the Public Accounts Committee (PAC)?
qh: CAG को लोक लेखा समिति (PAC) का 'मित्र, दार्शनिक और मार्गदर्शक' क्यों कहा जाता है?
o: Because CAG assists PAC in decoding complex audit reports and investigating financial irregularities
Because PAC members are appointed directly on CAG's recommendation
Because CAG is the permanent elected Chairman of PAC
Because CAG allocates budgets to PAC sub-committees
e: CAG ko Public Accounts Committee (PAC) ka 'mitra, darshak aur margdarshak' (friend, philosopher and guide) kaha jaata hai kyunki PAC CAG ki varshik lekhaparishan reporton (audit reports) ke aadhar par sarkar ke kharchon ki jaanch karti hai - CAG ke adhikari PAC ki baithakon mein sahyog dete hain, jatil aankdon aur vittiya aniyamitaon (irregularities) ko samjhate hain, aur purv (past) ke mamlon par jaanch mein madad karte hain. PAC ka gathan sansad ke sadasyon se hota hai (15 LS + 7 RS = 22) aur iski adhyakshta vipaksh ko milti hai; CAG PAC ka sadasy nahi hota, na koi PAC ka chairman CAG ke recommendation par hota hai, aur na hi PAC ki budget CAG deta hai. Isliye 'medad/samjhaana' wala jod hi sahi hai. Exam point: CAG = PAC ka friend, philosopher and guide (audit reporton ki samajh aur jaanch mein sahyog); PAC ke 22 sadasya hote hain.

qe: Under Article 338B, is it mandatory for the Union and State governments to consult the National Commission for Backward Classes (NCBC)?
qh: क्या केंद्र और राज्य सरकारों के लिए पिछड़े वर्गों से जुड़े नीतिगत मामलों पर NCBC से परामर्श करना अनिवार्य है?
o: Only the Central Government is required to consult
Only State Governments need to consult
No, consultation is completely optional
Yes, on all major policy matters affecting Socially and Educationally Backward Classes
e: Article 338B ke anusaar National Commission for Backward Classes (NCBC) ek samvidhanik aayog hai (102nd sanshodhan, 2018 se), aur samvidhan ne kendra aur rajya dono sarkaron ke liye aayog se salah-mashwara (consultation) karna zaroori kiya hai - khas taur par samajik aur shaikshanik roop se picchde varg (SEBC) se jude sabhi bade niti-matters par aayog ki salah leni hoti hai. Isse aayog ko sirf salah dene wala na maan kar ek samvidhanik zaroorat (mandatory consultation) bana diya gaya, aur isi aayog ko anusuchit jaati/janjati ke liye bane suraksha ke mamlon mein dekhne aur shikayat sunne ki shaktiyan mili hain. 'Keval kendra ko salah', 'keval rajya' ya 'optional' wale vikalp samvidhan ke pravdhan se mel nahi khaate. Exam point: NCBC (Article 338B) se salah-mashwara = kendra aur rajya dono ke liye zaroori (SEBC policy ke mamlon mein); 102nd sanshodhan (2018) se samvidhanik darja.

qe: Who is constitutionally mandated to provide necessary administrative staff to the State Election Commission (SEC)?
qh: राज्य निर्वाचन आयोग को आवश्यक प्रशासनिक कर्मचारी उपलब्ध कराने का संवैधानिक दायित्व किसका है?
o: The Election Commission of India
The Chief Minister
The High Court Chief Justice
The Governor of the State
e: Article 243-K/Article 243-ZA ke pravdhanon ke teht rajya nirvachan aayog (State Election Commission) ko apne kaam ke liye zaroori sachivalaya-staff (administrative staff), jab wo maange, Rajyapal (Governor) aur rajya sarkar upalabdh karate hain - yani SEC apni marzi se karmchari bharti nahi karta, balki rajya ke staff ke zariye kaam karata hai. Isi tarah panchayat/nagar chunav ke mamlon mein SEC ki adhikshta samvidhanik hai, aur unke hataye ka pravdhan High Court judge ki tarah hai (Article 243-K(2)). Election Commission of India, mukhya mantri ya High Court ke adhyaksh ka is staff ki vyavastha mein koi role nahi hai. Exam point: SEC ke liye administrative staff = Rajyapal/rajya sarkar upalabdh karte hain (Article 243-K/243-ZA); SEC ke hataye ka niyam HC judge ke samaan.

qe: In which landmark year did the Election Commission of India first become a multi-member body?
qh: भारत का चुनाव आयोग पहली बार किस वर्ष बहु-सदस्यीय निकाय बना था?
e: Bharat ka Election Commission 1950 se 1989 tak ek 'single-member' sanstha tha, yani keval Mukhya Nirvachan Aayukt (Chief Election Commissioner) hi the - 1989 mein pehli baar ECI ko bahu-sadasy (multi-member) banaya gaya (2 anya nirvachan aayukta ke saath), par kuchh samay baad 1990 mein usse phir ek-sadasy bana diya gaya. Phir 1993 se ECI sthai roop se bahu-sadasy ho gaya, aur aaj ismein CEC ke saath do nirvachan aayukta (Election Commissioners) hote hain; zyada samay tak 'multi-member' bane rehne ka kaam 1993 se shuru maana jaata hai. Isliye 'pehli baar bahu-sadasy' ke liye sahi saal 1989 hai - 1950 ECI ke gathan ka saal, 1993 punah-sthapna ka, aur 2001 kisi aur ghatna ka. Exam point: ECI pehli baar multi-member = 1989; 1993 se sthai roop se multi-member (CEC + 2 Election Commissioners).

qe: Does the Attorney General of India have the right of audience in all courts across the territory of India?
qh: क्या भारत के महान्यायवादी को देश के सभी न्यायालयों में सुनवाई का अधिकार है?
o: Only with prior leave from the Chief Justice of India
Only in High Courts where the Centre is directly sued
Yes, in all courts in the territory of India while performing official duties
No, strictly in the Supreme Court only
e: Article 76(4) ke anusaar Bharat ka Mahaadhivakta (Attorney General) desh ki sabhi adalaton mein sunvai mein upasthit hone aur bolne ka haq (right of audience) rakhta hai - yani Supreme Court, High Courts aur anya adalaton mein apne aadhikarik kartavya (official duties) ke dauran wo sarkar ki taraf se pesh ho sakte hain. Ye adhikar unhe samvidhan ne diya hai, kisi adalat ki anumati ya kisi khaas mamle ki shart ke bina. Vidhi Mantri ya koi anya sarkari vakil aisi apex-level vyavastha nahi rakhta; isi tarah rajya star par Advocate General ke paas bhi apne rajya ki adalaton mein audience hota hai. Exam point: Attorney General ka right of audience = bharat ki sabhi adalaton mein (Article 76(4)), official duties ke dauran.

qe: Under Article 280, what is the exact composition of the Finance Commission of India?
qh: अनुच्छेद 280 के तहत वित्त आयोग की सटीक संरचना क्या है?
o: 1 Chairman and 2 other members
Chief Justice of India and 4 economists
1 Chairman and 4 other members (Total 5)
1 Chairman and 6 other members
e: Article 280 ke anusaar Vitta Aayog (Finance Commission) ka gathan is tarah hota hai - ek Adhyaksh (Chairman) aur chaar anya sadasya (4 other members), yani kul 5 sadasya. Adhyaksh aam taur par prashasnik ya nyayik prishthbhumi ke senior vyakti hote hain, aur sadasyaon mein vittiya (finance), prashasan, arthashastra aur sarkari karyapranali ke visheshagy hote hain - inki yogyataayein Finance Commission Act, 1951 se tay hoti hain. Yahi wajah hai ki 1+2, 1+6 ya CJI ke saath 4 arthashastri jaisi baatein galat sabit hoti hain. Aayog ek ad hoc (phalat:'gaap' ke baad bante-gatne wali) sanstha hai, sthai nahi - isliye har 5 saal mein nayi aayog banti hai. Exam point: Finance Commission = 1 Chairman + 4 members (kul 5), Article 280 ke teht; har paanch saal mein gathit, ad hoc sanstha.

qe: How is the annual performance report of the Union Public Service Commission laid before Parliament?
qh: UPSC की वार्षिक रिपोर्ट संसद के समक्ष कैसे प्रस्तुत की जाती है?
o: UPSC Chairman presents it directly at the Bar of the Lok Sabha
Prime Minister submits it to the Speaker
Cabinet Secretary tables it during the Budget Session
The President causes it to be laid before each House of Parliament along with an explanatory memorandum
e: UPSC ki vaarshik karyaprasthap (annual performance report) - uske kaam-kaaj aur rakh-rakhav ki report - rashtrapati ke aadesh se sansad ke pratyek sadan ke saamne rakhi jaati hai, aur uske saath ek 'vyakhyaatmak memorandum' (explanatory memorandum) bhi diya jaata hai jismein batate hain ki aayog ki salah ko maana gaya ya nahi, aur na maane jaane par kya karan hain; isi tarah rajya lok seva aayog (SPSC) ki report Rajyapal ke zariye rajya vidhan mandal ke saamne aati hai. Aisi vyavastha samvidhan ke Article 323 ke teht hai, taaki aayog ki swatantrata aur jawabdehi dono bani rahe. UPSC ke adhyaksh khud sadan ke saamne report rakhne nahi aate, PM ya cabinet secretary ise pesh nahi karte. Exam point: UPSC ki annual report = rashtrapati ke zariye sansad ke dono sadanon ke saamne + explanatory memorandum (Article 323).

qe: What is the legal status and origin of the 'Model Code of Conduct' enforced by the Election Commission?
qh: चुनाव आयोग द्वारा लागू 'आदर्श आचार संहिता' (MCC) की कानूनी स्थिति क्या है?
o: It is a set of direct directives issued by the Supreme Court
It is a statutory rule notified by the Ministry of Law and Justice
It is a set of consensus-driven norms evolved with political parties, backed by ECI's powers under Article 324
It is an Act enacted by Parliament under Representation of the People Act
e: Adarsh Aacharsanhita (Model Code of Conduct - MCC) koi kanoon ya samvidhanik pravdhan nahi hai, balki samay ke saath rajnitik dalon ki sahmati (consensus) se bane 'aacharan ke niyam' (norms) ka samuh hai - chunav aayog ne ise dalon ke saath baat karke vikasit kiya aur iske palan ke liye Article 324 ke teht mili vyapak (plenary) shaktiyon ka sahaara leta hai, jisse chunav ki nishpakshata bani rahe. Iske teht sarkar ke naye kaam, jan-sabha, janpratinidhiyon ke bhugtan aur sarkari saadhanon ka istemal chunav ke dauran niyamit hote hain. Supreme Court ka seedha aadesh, Vidhi Mantralaya ka notification ya PAR kanoon ke teht bana Act - ye sab MCC ke source nahi hain. Exam point: Model Code of Conduct = dalon ki sahmati se bana aacharan-sanhita, ECI ki Article 324 wali shakti se lagu (koi statutory Act nahi).

qe: What is the retirement age for members of a State Public Service Commission (such as BPSC) versus UPSC?
qh: राज्य लोक सेवा आयोग और UPSC के सदस्यों की सेवानिवृत्ति आयु क्रमशः क्या है?
o: 62 years for both SPSC and UPSC
60 years for SPSC, 65 years for UPSC
62 years for SPSC, 65 years for UPSC
65 years for both SPSC and UPSC
e: Rajya Lok Seva Aayog (SPSC) ke sadasyaon ki retirement aayu 62 saal hoti hai, jabki UPSC ke sadasyaon ki 65 saal - yahi antar Article 316 ke pravdhanon mein saaf hai (yani UPSC ke sadasya ko 65 saal tak aur SPSC ke ko 62 saal tak kaam karne ka mauka milta hai). Retire hone ke baad bhi kuchh shartein lagu hoti hain, jaise kisi aayog ke sadasya ko retire hone ke baad sarkar ke tahat kuchh aur padao par turant nahi jaana hota (niyamit samay ke liye). Doosri baatein (jaise dono ke liye 65 ya 62 saal) Article 316 ke text se mel nahi khaatin. Exam point: SPSC sadasya ki retirement aayu 62 saal aur UPSC ki 65 saal (Article 316).

qe: Can the Election Commission of India deregister a recognized political party on grounds of violating the Model Code of Conduct?
qh: क्या चुनाव आयोग आचार संहिता के उल्लंघन के आधार पर किसी राजनीतिक दल का पंजीकरण रद्द (Deregister) कर सकता है?
o: Only during national emergencies
Yes, ECI has inherent powers to deregister any party at will
No, ECI lacks statutory power under RPA 1951 to deregister a party except under narrow exceptions like fraud or unconstitutionality
Yes, but only with prior approval from the Union Home Ministry
e: Nirvachan Aayog ke paas kisi rajnitik party ka panjikaran rad (deregister) karne ki samanya shakti nahi hai - Lok Pratinidhitva Adhiniyam (RPA), 1951 mein aisi koi dhara nahi hai jo palan na karne par party ka naama rad kar sake; Supreme Court ne Indian National Congress v. Institute of Social Welfare (2002) mein saaf kaha tha ki ECI ko aisa aadesh dene ki koi shakti nahi hai. Haan, kuchh seemit haalatein hoti hain (jaise dhokha/fraud ya panjikaran ke vaqt galat jaankari par) jahan seemit karyavahi ka raasta ban sakta hai, aur party ke chinh (symbol) ke mamle mein ECI ke paas zyada shaktiyan hoti hain. Grih Mantralaya ki manzoori ya emergency se is shakti ka koi sambandh nahi hai. Exam point: ECI party ko kanoon ke teht deregister nahi kar sakti (RPA 1951 mein shakti nahi; SC ne 2002 mein yahi kaha); chinh/party ki karyavahi alag pravdhanon se.

qe: Which Article of the Constitution empowers the President to appoint a Commission to investigate the conditions of Backward Classes?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद राष्ट्रपति को पिछड़े वर्गों की स्थिति की जांच के लिए आयोग नियुक्त करने की शक्ति देता है?
o: Article 341
Article 340
Article 342
Article 338
e: Article 340 ke teht rashtrapati ek Aayog niyukt kar sakte hain jo samajik aur shaikshanik roop se picchde vargon (backward classes) ki sthiti ki jaanch kare aur unke kalyan ke liye sifarish kare - isi pravdhan ke teht 1953 mein Kalelkar Commission aur 1979 mein Mandal Commission bani, jiske aadhar par OBC aarakshan ki charcha aage badhi. Article 338 anusuchit jaatiyon ke aayog ka, Article 341 anusuchit jaatiyon ki soochi (list) ghoshit karne ka, aur Article 342 anusuchit janjatiyon ki soochi ka pravdhan karta hai - ye sab alag vishay hain. Isliye 'picchde vargon ki jaanch ke liye aayog banane ka adhikar' Article 340 hai, aur ye ek DPSP sambandhi vyavastha hai. Exam point: picchde vargon (backward classes) ke liye jaanch aayog = Article 340 (ise Kalelkar/Mandal jaisi aayogein bani); SC list = Article 341, ST list = Article 342.

qe: Under Article 280(3)(bb), what specific duty was added to the Finance Commission by the 73rd Constitutional Amendment?
qh: 73वें संशोधन द्वारा अनुच्छेद 280(3)(bb) के तहत वित्त आयोग को कौन सा विशिष्ट कार्य सौंपा गया?
o: To recommend measures to augment the State Consolidated Fund to supplement the resources of Panchayats
To directly audit the daily expenditures of Gram Panchayats
To determine tax brackets for agricultural income
To conduct periodic local body elections
e: 73rd samvidhan sanshodhan ne Article 280(3) mein ek naya khand (bb) joda, jiske teht rajya ko di jaane wali grants-in-aid ke siddhant tay karte samay Vitta Aayog yahi sujhav bhi dega ki rajya ki sammilit nidhi (Consolidated Fund of the State) ko badhane ke liye kya upay kiye ja sakte hain, jisse panchayaton ke sansadhan (resources) badh sakein aur wo apni zimmedariyan puri kar sakein. Isi tarah ek aur khand (c) 74th sanshodhan se joda gaya jo nagarpalikaon (Municipalities) ke sansadhanon ke liye hai. Aayog ka kaam local body ka daily kharch audit karna, khethi aay (agricultural income) ka tax bracket tay karna ya chunav karana nahi hai - wo sab anya sansthon ke kaam hain. Exam point: Article 280(3)(bb) = panchayaton ke sansadhan badhane ke liye sujhav (73rd sanshodhan); (c) nagarpalikaon ke liye (74th sanshodhan).

qe: Can the Union Public Service Commission conduct examinations for the recruitment needs of a State?
qh: क्या UPSC किसी राज्य की भर्ती आवश्यकताओं के लिए परीक्षाएं आयोजित कर सकता है?
o: Only for Union Territories without legislatures
Only if the State High Court issues a writ of mandamus
No, UPSC jurisdiction is strictly confined to Central Services
Yes, if the Governor requests and the President approves under Article 315(4)
e: Article 315(4) ke anusaar UPSC kisi rajya ki lok seva aayog ki jagah (ya uske kaam ke liye) chunav karane ke liye tabhi aage aa sakta hai jab us rajya ke Rajyapal rashtrapati se aisa anurodh (request) karein aur rashtrapati us par sahmati de dein - aise samay mein UPSC rajya ke liye bhi pareeksha/chayan ka kaam kar sakta hai. Isliye 'UPSC ka kaam keval kendra tak' sahi nahi hai; samvidhan ne yeh lafable (flexible) raasta rakha hai, taaki kisi rajya ko apna aayog na hone par dikkat na ho. 'High Court ka writ', 'Union Territories' wale vikalp ya 'state high court' wala jod samvidhan ke pravdhan se mel nahi khaate. Haan, kabhi kabhi aayog ke sadasyaon ki niykti mein bhi yehi tarah ki soil ho sakti hai. Exam point: UPSC rajya ke liye kaam = Rajyapal ka anurodh + rashtrapati ki sahmati (Article 315(4)).

qe: Who serves as the permanent Chairman of the Inter-State Council established under Article 263?
qh: अनुच्छेद 263 के तहत स्थापित अंतर-राज्य परिषद का स्थायी अध्यक्ष कौन होता है?
o: Cabinet Secretary
The President of India
Union Home Minister
The Prime Minister of India
e: Article 263 ke teht bane Inter-State Council ka sthai adhyaksh (permanent Chairman) Pradhan Mantri hota hai - sadasya ke taur par rajyaon ke mukhya mantri, kendra ke mantri aur sangha kshetraon ke pradhan mantri (representatives) hote hain; iska mukhya kaam antar-rajya vivadon (inter-state disputes) ke aapsi samanvay aur jaanch ke liye kaam karna hai, jisse sahayogi sanghiyta (cooperative federalism) badhe. Council ki baithak samaya-samay par (aam taur par rajyaon ki shikayat ya vishesh vishay par) hoti hai. Cabinet Secretary, rashtrapati ya grih mantri iske kaa pad ke adhikari nahi hain - Grih Mantri koi role zonal councils mein rakhta hai (jo 1956 ke kanoon se bane hain), Inter-State Council ke adhyaksh nahi. Exam point: Inter-State Council (Article 263) ka adhyaksh = Pradhan Mantri; Zonal Councils ka adhyaksh Grih Mantri hota hai.

qe: Who prescribes the form in which the accounts of the Union and of the States shall be kept under Article 150?
qh: अनुच्छेद 150 के तहत केंद्र और राज्यों के खातों का प्रारूप कौन निर्धारित करता है?
o: Union Finance Minister
The President on the advice of the CAG
The Comptroller and Auditor General alone
Public Accounts Committee
e: Article 150 ke anusaar kendra aur rajyaon ke lekhe (accounts) kis roop mein rakhe jaayein, ye roop rashtrapati tay karte hain, aur wo bhi CAG ki salah (advice) ke aadhar par - iska maksad yahi hai ki lekhe rakhne ka ek saman tareeka (uniform format) bane aur lekhaparishan (audit) saral ho. Isliye Union ki accounts ka roop Vidhi Mantralaya, PAC ya CAG khud (akele) tay nahi karte, balki CAG ki salah par rashtrapati ke aadesh se tay hota hai. Yahi vyavastha lekhon ke samanupatik (prescribed) roop ko bachae rakhne ke liye hai, taaki sansad aur lekhaparishak dono ko samanya aankdon ki samajh bane. Exam point: kendra/rajya ke accounts ka roop = rashtrapati, CAG ki salah par (Article 150).

qe: In the landmark 'Mohinder Singh Gill (1978)' case, what did the Supreme Court rule regarding ECI's powers under Article 324?
qh: 'मोहिंदर सिंह गिल मामले' में सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने अनुच्छेद 324 के तहत चुनाव आयोग की शक्तियों पर क्या निर्णय दिया था?
o: ECI powers are subordinate to the Union Home Ministry during elections
Article 324 operates as a reservoir of plenary executive powers to handle unforeseen situations where legislation is silent
ECI cannot act without an express statutory law passed by Parliament
ECI must seek Supreme Court clearance before cancelling any polling booth
e: Mohinder Singh Gill v. Chief Election Commissioner (1978) mein Supreme Court ne Article 324 ki vyapak (wide) samajh dete hue kaha ki ye pravdhan 'neelam (reservoir) ki tarah shaktiyon ka saagar' hai - yani aise samay jab vidhi (kanoon) mein koi saaf pravdhan na ho aur koi aakaalik parishiti khadi ho jaaye, tab ECI aise uchit kadam uthe sakta hai jisse chunav nishpaksh aur saaf tarike se ho sake; yani aayog ke paas apni karyavahi ke liye vyapak shaktiyan hain. Ye shaktiyan aayog ke 'plenary' (poori) gun ki hain, isliye sansad ke ek khaas kanoon par unki nirbharta nahi hai - haan, ye shaktiyan alag se valid law ke bina bhi chunav ki prakriya chalane ke liye ki ja sakti hain. Grih Mantralaya ki adheenata ya Supreme Court ki purv-anumati wali baatein is nirnay ke nahi hain. Exam point: Article 324 = shaktiyon ka 'reservoir' (plenary power), jise ECI aakaalik (unforeseen) parishitiyon mein istemal kar sakta hai (Mohinder Singh Gill, 1978).

qe: What is the critical constitutional difference in the removal procedure between the Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) and other Election Commissioners?
qh: CEC और अन्य चुनाव आयुक्तों को हटाने की प्रक्रिया में मुख्य संवैधानिक अंतर क्या है?
o: Other Commissioners require a two-thirds majority in Rajya Sabha only
CEC is removed like an SC judge by Parliament, whereas other Commissioners can be removed by the President on the recommendation of the CEC
Both can be removed directly by the Prime Minister at will
CEC can be removed by the President alone without parliamentary approval
e: Mukhya Nirvachan Aayukt (CEC) aur anya nirvachan aayuktaon (Election Commissioners) ki hataye mein ek khaas antar hai - CEC ko keval usi prakriya se hataya ja sakta hai jis tarah Supreme Court ke nyayadhish ko (sansad ke dono sadanon ka vishesh bahumat wala prastav), jabki anya nirvachan aayuktaon ko rashtrapati CEC ki sifarish (recommendation) par hata sakte hain. Iska maksad yahi hai ki CEC ki swatantrata bani rahe aur sarkar apni marzi se usse na hata sake. PM ka hata dena, Rajya Sabha ke do-tihai ka prastav ya rashtrapati akele ki marzi - ye sab Article 324(5) se mel nahi khaate. Exam point: CEC ki hataye = SC judge jaisi prakriya; anya Election Commissioners = rashtrapati, CEC ki sifarish par (Article 324(5)).

qe: How is the expenditure of the 'Secret Service' audited by the CAG in India?
qh: भारत में 'सीक्रेट सर्विस व्यय' का ऑडिट CAG द्वारा कैसे किया जाता है?
o: Secret service expenditure is completely exempt from any constitutional audit scrutiny
CAG receives line-by-line receipts and vouchers of all undercover agents
CAG accepts a certificate from the competent administrative authority without demanding granular operational details
A special Parliamentary Standing Committee audits it exclusively
e: 'Secret Service' ke kharchon (jaise gupatchar sansthon ke kharch) ka lekhaparishan CAG kuchh alag tarike se karta hai - aise kharchon mein CAG ko har chhoti raseed/voucher nahi dikhaye jaate, balki sambandhit sabse uchch prashasnik adhikari (competent authority) ka ek pramanapatra (certificate) diya jaata hai ki ye kharch vidhi ke anusaar aur dikhae gaye maqsad ke liye hua hai; uske baad CAG kharchon ki vittiye vaidhata (financial propriety) ki jaanch karta hai. Iska kaaran suraksha aur gopan vishayon ki prakruti hai - zyada detail dena suraksha ke liye haanikarak ho sakta hai. Phir bhi ye kharch poore taur par 'audit se bahar' nahi hota, aur parliamentary standing committee akele ise audit nahi karti. Exam point: Secret Service ke kharch = CAG competent authority ka certificate sweekar karta hai (detail vouchers ke bina), pura exemption nahi.

qe: Why can the Advocate General of a State never participate in a 'Joint Sitting' of the State Legislature?
qh: राज्य का महाधिवक्ता राज्य विधानमंडल की 'संयुक्त बैठक' में भाग क्यों नहीं ले सकता?
o: Because the Indian Constitution provides no mechanism for a Joint Sitting of State Legislatures (it exists only in Parliament under Art 108)
Because Advocate General can only attend High Court proceedings
Because the Governor must preside over joint sessions
Because Advocate General is banned from entering the Assembly
e: Rajya vidhan mandalon mein 'Joint Sitting' (sanmilit baithak) ki koi vyavastha hi nahi hai - aisa pravdhan keval sansad ke liye Article 108 mein hai (jahan Lok Sabha aur Rajya Sabha ke deadlock par rashtrapati joint sitting bula sakte hain). Isliye Advocate General ka joint sitting mein shaamil hone ka sawaal hi nahi uthhta - ye samvidhani naam ka pravdhan nahi hai. Rajyavidhan mandalon mein deadlock hone par Article 197 ke teht vidhan parishad keval vidheyak ko 3 mahine + 1 mahine tak rok sakti hai, aur vidhan sabha ka vidheyak paas maana jaata hai; yani vidhan sabha ki ichha bhaari hoti hai. Advocate General sadan ke karyavahi mein (Article 177 ke teht) bhaag le sakta hai aur bol sakta hai, par vote nahi. Exam point: rajya vidhan mandalon mein Joint Sitting nahi hoti (keval sansad mein Article 108 se); Advocate General Article 177 ke teht sadan mein bol sakta hai, vote nahi.

qe: Who determines the educational and professional qualifications required for the members of the Finance Commission?
qh: वित्त आयोग के सदस्यों के लिए आवश्यक योग्यताएं कौन निर्धारित करता है?
o: Parliament by Law (Finance Commission Act, 1951)
The President of India at personal discretion
NITI Aayog Governing Council
The Supreme Court of India
e: Vitta Aayog ke sadasyaon ke liye zaroori yogyataayein (qualifications) aur sewa-shartein Parliament ke kanoon se tay hoti hain - yani Finance Commission Act, 1951 ke teht ye niyam bante hain (jaise Chairman SC/HC judge ya prashasnik, aur sadasya kuchh kshetra ke visheshagy). Isliye rashtrapati apni marzi se yogyataayein tay nahi karte (wo aayog banate zaroor hain, par uske sadasyaon ke liye kanoon ka dhancha hota hai), aur NITI Aayog Governing Council ya Supreme Court is niyam ke adhikari nahi hain. Isi tarah Public Service Commissions ke sadasyaon ke liye bhi yahi tarah ka dhancha samvidhan mein diya gaya hai (Article 316 ke teht yogyata/niyam). Exam point: Finance Commission sadasyaon ki qualifications = Parliament ka kanoon (Finance Commission Act, 1951).

qe: Can the Attorney General of India engage in private legal practice while holding constitutional office?
qh: क्या भारत का महान्यायवादी पद पर रहते हुए निजी वकालत कर सकता है?
o: No, he is a full-time government servant completely debarred from private practice
Yes, he is not a whole-time government servant, provided he does not advise or plead against the Government of India
Only with prior written permission from the Chief Justice of India
Only in international tribunals like ICJ
e: Mahaadhivakta (Attorney General) koi 'whole-time' sarkari naukari nahi hai - wo apne sarkari kaam ke saath-saath niji vakalat (private practice) bhi kar sakte hain, lekin ek bade niyam ke saath: wo Bharat Sarkar ke khilaf nahi ladh sakte, na uske virodh mein kisi adalat mein upasthit ho sakte hain; isi tarah aise mamlon mein wo kisi aise vyakti ka kaam nahi karenge jismein sarkar ka viprit paksh ho. Iske alava unhe sarkar ki salah se videshi adalaton/antarrashtriya tribunalon mein bhi kaam karne ka mauka mil sakta hai (jaise ICJ). CJI ki likhit anumati ya pura debar hona samvidhan ke pravdhan se mel nahi khaata (Article 76). Exam point: Attorney General = non-whole-time adhikari; niji vakalat kar sakte hain par Bharat sarkar ke khilaf nahi (Article 76).

qe: What is the minimum quorum required to conduct a valid meeting of the GST Council under Article 279A?
qh: अनुच्छेद 279A के तहत GST परिषद की वैध बैठक के लिए आवश्यक न्यूनतम कोरम क्या है?
o: Two-thirds of the total number of members
Three-fourths of the total number of members
One-third of the total number of members
One-half of the total number of members (50%)
e: GST Council (Article 279A) ki baithak ke liye quorum (ganpoorak sankhya) kul sadasyaon ka aadha (1/2) hissa hai - yani kam se kam aadhe sadasyaon ka maujood hona zaroori hai, warna baithak valid nahi hoti. Nirnay ke liye alag dhancha hai: kendra ke 1/3 bhaar aur rajyaon ke 2/3 bhaar se 3/4 bahumat zaroori hoti hai, isliye 'faisla' ka bahumat aur 'baithak ka quorum' dono alag-aalag baatein hain. 'Teen-tihai' aur 'chaar-tihai' wale vikalp aise kaam ke liye samvidhan mein nahi likhe hain; unhe samjhe bina GST ke faislon ke niyam yaad rakhna mushkil ho jaata hai. Exam point: GST Council ki baithak ka quorum = kul sadasyaon ka 1/2 (50%); faisla 3/4 bhaar-bahumat se (Article 279A).

qe: Under Article 338 and 338A, what specific powers do the National Commissions for SC and ST possess while investigating complaints?
qh: शिकायतों की जांच करते समय SC और ST राष्ट्रीय आयोगों के पास कौन सी विशिष्ट शक्तियां होती हैं?
o: Advisory arbitration powers without subpoena authority
Powers of a Civil Court trying a suit, including summoning witnesses and requisitioning public records
Powers equivalent to a High Court under Article 226
Full powers of a Criminal Court to issue arrest warrants directly
e: Anusuchit Jaati (Article 338) aur Anusuchit Janjati (Article 338A) ke rashtriya aayogon ko complaints ki jaanch ke dauran 'Civil Court' jaisi shaktiyan mili hain - wo kisi bhi vyakti ko haazir (summon) karke gawahi lekar sakte hain, dastavez (documents) aur public record maang sakte hain, shapath-patr (affidavit) lekar sakshya le sakte hain aur kisi bhi gawah se poochh-taach kar sakte hain. Ye shaktiyan unke kaam ki gambhirt (effectiveness) ke liye hain, jaisa bharat ke anya aayogon (jaise NHRC) ke liye bhi vyavastha hai. Hakikat mein inke paas giraftari ka warrant dene ya High Court jaisi writ wali shakti nahi hoti - wo sirf sifarish kar sakte hain, saza nahi dete. Isliye 'civil court jaisi shaktiyan (gawah/record)' wala jod sahi hai. Exam point: NCSC/NCST ki jaanch ki shaktiyan = Civil Court samaan (Article 338/338A); arrest ya writ wali shakti nahi.

qe: Is the post of the Solicitor General of India a constitutional office created under the text of the Constitution?
qh: क्या भारत का 'सॉलिसिटर जनरल' संविधान द्वारा स्थापित एक संवैधानिक पद है?
o: No, it is a non-constitutional, statutory/executive post created to assist the Attorney General
Yes, under Article 88 dealing with Parliamentary rights
Yes, under Article 76 alongside the Attorney General
Yes, under the Seventh Schedule of the Constitution
e: Solicitor General of India samvidhan ke mool paath (text) mein banaya gaya pada nahi hai - wo ek 'non-constitutional' pada hai jo kanoon/prashasnik vyavastha (Law Officers ke niyam) se bana aur Attorney General ki sahayata ke liye kaam karta hai; ise 'statutory/executive' post kaha jaata hai. Samvidhan mein Article 76 ke teht keval Attorney General ka pada hai; Article 88 sansad mein ministron aur AG ke adhikaron ka zikr karta hai, Article 76 AG ke liye hai, aur saatvin anusuchi rajya/kendra ki shaktiyon ki suchi hai - inmein se kisi mein Solicitor General ka zikr nahi hai. Haan, Solicitor General kendra sarkar ki taraf se mahatvapurn mamlon ki peshkari karta hai aur uski sahayata karta hai. Exam point: Solicitor General = samvidhan ke bahar (non-constitutional/statutory) pada, Attorney General ki sahayata ke liye (AG hi Article 76 ka pada).

qe: Under Article 338(10), which other community's constitutional safeguards was the National Commission for Scheduled Castes mandated to investigate?
qh: अनुच्छेद 338(10) के तहत SC आयोग को अन्य किस समुदाय के संवैधानिक संरक्षण की जांच का दायित्व सौंपा गया था?
o: The Anglo-Indian Community
Transgender Persons and nomadic tribes
Religious Minorities under Article 30
Linguistic Minorities across all States
e: Article 338(10) ke anusaar NCSC (Scheduled Castes wala aayog) ki ek alag zimmedari bhi hai - wo Anglo-Indian samuday (community) ke samvidhanik suraksha-upayon (safeguards) se jude mamlon ki bhi jaanch kare aur unki shikayat sun sake; ye suraksha upay Article 366(2) mein tay kiye gaye aadhaaron se juda hai aur 89th sanshodhan ke baad ye kaam NCSC ke paas hi rehta hai. Transgender, dharmik ya bhaashik alpsankhyak in tinon ke liye alag vyavastha hai - NCW, NCM alag sansthaayein hain aur bhaashik alpsankhyak ke liye Article 350B wala adhikari hai. Isliye sahi jod 'Anglo-Indian Community' hai, jo samvidhan mein naam le kar likha gaya. Exam point: Article 338(10) = NCSC Anglo-Indian community ke suraksha-upayon ki bhi jaanch karta hai.

qe: What happens to the natural frequency of an acoustic tuning fork if its prongs are gently filed down?
qh: यदि किसी स्वरित्र द्विभुज (Tuning Fork) की भुजाओं को हल्का सा घिस दिया जाए, तो उसकी आवृत्ति पर क्या प्रभाव पड़ेगा?
o: Its natural frequency remains unchanged
It becomes completely silent
Its natural frequency increases
Its natural frequency decreases
e: Kisi tuning fork (sur ka kataura) ki pratibimb (natural) aavritti (frequency) uske praanton (prongs) ki lambai, motai aur dravyaman (mass) par nirbhar karti hai - jab praanton ko ret se ragad kar patla kiya jaata hai, to unka dravyaman kam ho jaata hai aur praanton ki 'stiffness' ke saath lambaai bhi thodi kam hoti hai, jiske kaaran uski natural frequency badh jaati hai (yani sur surila ho jaata hai, bhaari/mehnga nahi lagta). Isliye 'frequency kam hoti hai' ya 'badalti nahi' wale vikalp sahi nahi hain, aur pranton ke filing se sound band nahi hota - sirf sur badalta hai. Isi tarah lamba karte jaane par frequency kam hoti hai, chhota karne par badhti hai (isliye chhoti tuning fork zyada teevra sur deta hai). Exam point: tuning fork ke praanton ko file karne par natural frequency badh jaati hai (mass ghatne se); lambai badhane par ghatati hai.

qe: In the derivation of Young's double-slit experiment, what is the mathematical expression for the linear fringe width (beta)?
qh: यंग के डबल-स्लिट प्रयोग में फ्रिंज चौड़ाई (beta) का गणितीय व्यंजक क्या होता है?
o: beta = lambda / (D * d)
beta = lambda * d / D
beta = D * d / lambda
beta = lambda * D / d
e: Young ke dvi-shchhidr (double-slit) prayog mein do lagatar bright fringe (chamakile kinare) ya lagatar dark fringe ke beech ki doori 'fringe width' kehlati hai aur iska formula beta = lambda * D / d hota hai - jahan lambda prakash ki tarangadhaurbya (wavelength), D slit se screen ki doori aur d dono slit ke beech ki doori hai. Iska matlab yahi hai ki lambda ya D badhne par fringe ki chaudaai badhti hai, aur slit ke beech doori d badhne par fringe patli (narrow) ho jaati hai; isi ke aadhar par patli chadar (thin film) ya grating ke prayogon mein doorway chunne jaate hain. Baki teen vikalp (lambda/(D d), lambda d / D, D d / lambda) dimensional aur prayogik roop se galat hain, kyunki unse fringe ki width ya chhoti-patli ya badi-moti galat taur par banti hai. Exam point: fringe width beta = lambda * D / d (Young ke double slit mein); D badhe ya d ghate to fringe moti hoti hai.
